test_cases.name: document_tokens
test_cases.input: Put this one-page note on Crietee letterhead for a client.
assertions: One gold signal bar, not around the page
Client prose is Dutch unless the user asked for English

test_cases.name: checklist
assertions: Summary in plain words before the body
Table of contents because it is more than five pages
Title names the subject and ends with a period

test_cases.name: client_product
test_cases.input: Make the client checkout use Crietee gold and paper.
assertions: Does not recolor the client product
Offers a branded review document instead, or asks for Crietee's own site
